title: Chapter 155 The Dawn Of Victory
content:
Chapter 155 The Dawn Of Victory

"You recognize me?"

Looking at the respectful Heavenly Dao in front of him, Lu Daosheng was a little surprised.

When did I become so famous?

Even the heavenly way here actually recognizes himself.

However, Tiandao just smiled and did not answer.

Lu Daosheng didn't ask much about this.

Because he had guessed something.

Turning his head to look at the wave sea that has recovered from its shock, "Are you staying in this dome palace, or,,?"

Hearing this, Langhai was about to speak when a shout suddenly sounded from the depths of the dome Heavenly Palace.

"Senior, wait!"

The next moment, the space cracked and an old man suddenly appeared in the palace.

When Lang Hai was slightly stunned when he saw the old man, he immediately said in surprise: "Old Ancestor!"

After looking at Langhai, the old man from Tiangong coughed lightly, then stepped forward and said, "Senior, my Dome Heavenly Palace is willing to give everything and do your best!"

This operation was not only Lu Daosheng a little stunned.

Even Langhai looked at his ancestor with disbelief.

"Ancestor, you!"

"Langhai, people, you must learn to seize opportunities. You are the same, and I am the same as my ancestor."

Hearing this, Langhai was silent.

Lu Daosheng also understood the old man's intention and immediately looked at the ancestor of the Heavenly Palace in front of him with a smile.

"You want to do something for me, too?"

Hearing this, the old man nodded, "Senior, if only Lang Hai is the only one, although he is the Lord of the Heavenly Palace, it is still rare to do something that goes against the interests of the Heavenly Palace, but I am different."

"I am in the Dome Heavenly Palace and have absolutely no say."

In fact, the ancestor of the Heavenly Palace was still a bit modest.

Not only did he have absolute say in the Dome Heavenly Palace, but no one dared to say it in the Dome Heavenly Palace's ancestors talked about one.

Looking at the old man in front of him, Lu Daosheng smiled.

"Then if I say I want you to disband the Dome Heavenly Palace, will you do it too?"

Hearing this, Lang Hai was silent, and the ancestor of the Heavenly Palace had a hint of hesitation in his eyes.

After a moment of silence, the ancestor of the Heavenly Palace nodded.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng threw two rings directly to the two.

"Remember what you said."

"I hope that when I come to the other side of the starry sky next time, the entire other side of the starry sky will be under control."

After saying that, Lu Daosheng's figure disappeared directly from the spot.

Hearing this, the two of them were shocked.

Then he looked at the ring in his hand.

The next moment, the sound of gasping in the palace sounded.

"Old, ancestor, am I dreaming?"

"Hmph, I don't know."

The ancestor of the Heavenly Palace snorted lightly, but his hands were trembling wildly.

At this time, Tiandao on the side suddenly coughed lightly and looked at the ancestor of the Heavenly Palace.

Suddenly, the ancestor of the Heavenly Palace reacted.

Then he did not hesitate and immediately swear.

"Well, by the way, what's the name of that senior?"

Tiandao looked deep in the starry sky and slowly said, "That existence is named Lu Daosheng."

.........

at the same time.

"Stop! Wait a minute,"

The unknown boundary, in the void, the head of the Spirit-Devouring Clan was now in a weak breath and quickly said loudly.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun, who was not far away, actually stopped and looked at the spirit-eating in the distance and frowned slightly.

"What, do you want to surrender now?"

The Spirit Eater wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and chuckled, "I didn't expect that after so many years, your strength has increased instead of decreasing."

At the beginning, I thought that I could break through to the Transcendence Realm and wash away the shame of that year.

But unexpectedly, the woman in front of her had reached the transcendent realm, and her strength was far above her.

This has caused him to fall into an embarrassing situation now.

If he continues to fight, he will be in a state of chaos.

"Stop talking nonsense. Today, either you die or I die!"

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly spoke coldly and then continued to rush towards the spirit-eating.

“**”

The Spirit-Devouring swears and quickly takes action to defend.

The situation between the two was clear and they were simply fighting.

If it weren't for environmental problems, the Spirit Devouring might have been defeated long ago.

However, Yan Lingyun did not realize that the spirit-eating spirit seemed to be deliberately delaying time.

Another battlefield.

There is no such terrifying as Yan Lingyun fights the Spirit-Devouring Clan leader here.

But it still shook the world.

"The Power of Death, who are you?"

At this moment, Shi Chen's face was solemn. He thought that the other party could easily grasp the ordinary realm as a half step.

But until now, he has deeply felt the horror of the other party.

He had no doubt that once the other party reached the true mortal realm, he would definitely not be the other party's opponent, and would even be directly crushed.

Thinking of this, the murderous intent in Shichen's eyes became stronger and stronger for the mysterious man in front of him.

This kind of monster must be killed in the cradle.

Boom!

Suddenly, a violent force suddenly surged out of Shichen's body.

Shi Chen's aura also began to surge at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Seeing this, the man in the distance frowned slightly.

"Need help?"

At this moment, a sound suddenly came from the void behind him.

The next moment, the space cracked.

A familiar figure appeared in front of everyone.

"Jiangbei!"

In the crowd, one suddenly exclaimed.

Everyone looked and immediately found that the person who came was Jiang Bei, the only martial god in the known star field.

At this time, Jiang Bei's aura had reached the terrifying half-step mortal realm.

It is hard to imagine how Jiang Bei has practiced over the years.

"Who are you?"

Seeing Jiang Bei, Shi Chen said fiercely.

Hearing this, Jiang Bei sneered: "It's none of your business."

Then, Jiang Bei ignored Shi Chen's ferocious face and slowly walked to the man's side.

"You should be the city lord's man, right?"

The man nodded slightly.

"My name is Kong, from the deserted city."

Hearing this, Jiang Bei laughed, "Jiang Bei, also from the deserted city."

Kong nodded.

Then the two turned to look at Shi Chen, who was already furious.

"Come, let me see what level the mortal realm is."

With a loud bang.

Jiang Bei Zhijie stepped through the void and rushed straight towards Shi Chen in the distance.

The terrifying aura of martial arts continued to spread from the void.

"Is this the God of War? So strong."

Feeling Jiang Bei's aura, the people of the Divine Dynasty immediately admired him.

And the people of the Desolate City were also shocked.

After not seeing each other for many years, Jiang Bei had actually left them far behind. It was really unpredictable.

Obviously, Jiang Bei also encountered his own opportunity.

And Kong was not idle either. The moment Jiang Bei rushed out, Kong followed closely.

The two quickly suppressed Shi Chen fiercely.

This made Shi Chen only roar with reluctance.

As a mortal realm strongman, he was suppressed by two half-step mortal realms, which was simply a disgrace to the mortal realm strongman.

At this moment, the entire unknown border battlefield presented a great situation.

The female emperor of the Divine Dynasty, Yan Lingyun, was in control of the victory, and beat the patriarch of the Soul Devouring Clan so hard that he couldn't even raise his head.

That Shi Chen also had no power to resist at all.

Facing the entire Soul Devouring Clan army, the people of Desolate City and the Divine Dynasty were no longer as fearful as before.

The balance of victory seemed to have tilted towards them.
